text:
maya: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Q3 customer pilot so infra/runtime/security know what's required.
arjun: +1. What's the minimal feature set customers need? We should avoid open-ended asks.
maya: Core asks: (1) private deployment with VPC + KMS, (2) 99th p95 latency <= 250ms for typical chat path, (3) snapshot export for audit logs.
sam: For runtime: the latency target depends on batch strategy. If we force single-token streaming with prefix cache warmed, 250ms is doable for medium models. Need prewarm slots.
liz: Prewarm is doable but needs a reserved capacity commit. How many concurrent sessions? We need an estimate to size GPUs and schedule prewarm.
maya: Start pilot with 5 tenants, expected concurrency 30 sessions total, burst to 60. That's our ask.
olga: Security: the KMS integration and export retention policy will need a security review. ETA for review: 10 business days after we hand over design docs.
tori: Engineering PM here — to meet olga's timeline we need to freeze schema for audit exports today. Any objections?
arjun: No objections. I'll post the minimal export schema in a sec.
maya: Cool. Also, we need a fallback plan if prewarm capacity isn't available: route to hosted model variant with a cost/latency tradeoff.
sam: We can implement routing policy that prefers private cluster, falls back to hosted small-model. That adds ~120ms, we should flag to customers.
liz: If we go hosted fallback, networking change is minimal. But for SLA, we must document that fallback will not meet private SLA.
maya: Understood — include that in customer onboarding docs.
arjun: Export schema (minimal):
```json
{"request_id":"string","user_id":"string","model":"string","tokens_generated":int,"timestamp":"iso"}
```
maya: Perfect.
olga: Also need affirmation on key rotation policy for KMS. Who owns it?
liz: Infra can own rotation process but devs must ensure re-encryption path exists. That needs a brief implementation spec.
tori: Action items: @arjun post full export spec by EOD; @sam propose prewarm sizing options by Wed; @liz cost estimate for reserved slots by Thu; @olga start security review with that spec once posted. I'll compile decisions and share the launch gating checklist.
arjun: Posting spec now: <link-to-gdoc>
sam: Quick question on prewarm sizing — do we want steady-state reserved or burst-only? Burst-only has lower monthly cost but slower tail latencies.
maya: For pilot, let's do small reserved (2 GPUs) + burst policy. We can reevaluate if usage exceeds 70% sustained.
liz: I'll model costs for 2 GPUs reserved + 4 burst. Sending numbers to the doc.
olga: Noted. Start security review once doc is live. If we see any crypto blockers I'll flag immediately.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline: private-deploy/pilot branch requires KMS creds in vault. PR check will fail until vault path configured.
arjun: Thanks. I'll add vault setup to the infra PR.
maya: Thanks team. We should have a decision thread update by Friday so sales/customer success can prep the pilot invites. :thumbsup:
sam: Will add an experiment for KV cache warmup and measure cold vs warm RTTs.
liz: One more: tagging requirement for cost allocation — please add tenant_id on every request header.
arjun: Added tenant_id to spec.
maya: Great — I'll close the decision doc once all items are in. If anything blocks security or infra timing we'll escalate in next standup.
